(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for ⁨דּבר⁩pi.,⁨שִׂיחַ⁩;] ⟪to talk with or together⟫: (c. dat. pers., ⟦Mark 9:4|Mk 9:4⟧, ⟦Luke 9:30|Lk 9:30⟧ ⟦Luke 22:4|22:4⟧; seq. μετά, c. gen., ⟦Matthew 17:3|Mt 17:3⟧, ⟦Acts 25:12|Ac 25:12⟧; . πρός, c. acc., ⟦Luke 4:36|Lk 4:36⟧.†

G4818.b:
⟪συν-λυπέω⟫
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 69:20|Ps 68 (69):20⟧, ⟦Isaiah 51:19|Is 51:19⟧ (⁨נוּד⁩) * ;] ⟪to make to grieve with⟫ (Arist.). Pass., ⟪to be moved to grief⟫ by sympathy: seq. ἐπί, c. dat., ⟦Mark 3:5|Mk 3:5⟧.†

G4827.b: * ⟪συν-μαθητής⟫ (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ ⟪a fellow-disciple⟫: ⟦John 11:16|Jo 11:16⟧ (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†
a: The New Phrynichus, by W. G. Rutherford. Macmillan, 1881

G4828.b: * ⟪συν-μαρτυρέω⟫ (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, ⟪to bear witness with⟫: ⟦Romans 2:15|Ro 2:15⟧; c. dat., ⟦Romans 8:16|Ro 8:16⟧; seq. ὅτι, ⟦Romans 9:1|Ro 9:1⟧.†

G4829.b:
† ⟪συν-μερίζω⟫
(Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 29:24|Pr 29:24⟧ ⁨א⁩2 (⁨חלק⁩) * ;] ⟪to distri­bute in shares⟫. Mid., ⟪to have a share in⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 9:13|I Co 9:13⟧ (Diod., al.).†

G4830.b: * ⟪συν-μέτοχος⟫ (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, ⟪partaking together with⟫; as subst., ὁ σ., ⟪a joint partaker⟫ (c. dat. pers. et gen. rei, FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): c. gen. rei, ⟦Ephesians 3:6|Eph 3:6⟧; c. gen. pers., ⟦Ephesians 5:7|ib. 5:7⟧ (Arist.).†

G4831.b: *† ⟪συν-μιμητής⟫ (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ ⟪a fellow-imitator⟫: c. gen. obj., ⟦Philippians 3:17|Phl 3:17⟧ (v. ICC, in l.). Not elsewhere.†

G4834.b:
** ⟪συν-παθέω⟫
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: IV Mac 5:25 AR 13:23 * ;] ⟪to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in⟫: c. dat. rei, ⟦Hebrews 4:15|He 4:15⟧; dat. pers., ⟦Hebrews 10:34|ib. 10:34⟧ (Arist., Plut., al.).†
a: St. Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians, by J. Armitage Robinson. Second Edition. Macmillan, 1909

G4836.b:
⟪συν-παρα-γίνομαι⟫
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 83:8|Ps 82 (83):8⟧ (⁨לוה⁩ ni.) * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to come up or be present together⟫: seq. ἐπί, ⟦Luke 23:48|Lk 23:48⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to come up to assist⟫ (Thuc., al.; ⟦2 Timothy 4:16|II Ti 4:16⟧, Rec.).†

G4837.b: * ⟪συν-παρα-καλέω⟫ (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, ⟪to call upon or exhort together⟫ (Plat.). Pass., ⟪to be strengthened or comforted with and among⟫: ⟦Romans 1:12|Ro 1:12⟧.†

G4838.b:
⟪συν-παρα-λαμβάνω⟫
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 19:17|Ge 19:17⟧ (⁨ספה⁩ ni.), ⟦Job 1:4|Jb 1:4⟧ (⁨שׁלח⁩), III Mac 1:1 * ;] ⟪to take along with⟫: as a companion, c. acc., ⟦Acts 12:25|Ac 12:25⟧ ⟦Acts 15:37|15:37, 38⟧ (on the tenses, v. M, Pr., 130), ⟦Galatians 2:1|Ga 2:1⟧.†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G4840.b:
⟪συν-πάρειμι⟫
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: To 12:12 ΑΒ, ⟦Proverbs 8:27|Pr 8:27⟧ (?), Wi 9:10 * ;] ⟪to be present together or with⟫: c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 25:24|Ac 25:24⟧.†

G4841.b:
** ⟪συν-πάσχω⟫
(Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: ⟦1 Samuel 22:8|I Ki 22:8⟧ * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to suffer together or with⟫: ⟦Romans 8:17|Ro 8:17⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:26|I Co 12:26⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to sympathize with⟫ (Plat., Arist.).†

G4842.b: * ⟪συν-πέμπω⟫ (Rec. συμπ-) ⟪to send together with⟫: c. acc. et dat., ⟦2 Corinthians 8:22|II Co 8:22⟧; id. seq. μετά, c. gen., ⟦2 Corinthians 8:18|ib. 18⟧.†

G4843.b:
⟪συν-περι-λαμβάνω⟫ (Rec. συμπ-),
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to enclose⟫ (⟦Ezekiel 5:3|Ez 5:3⟧ (⁨צוּר⁩) *).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to embrace⟫: c. acc. pers., ⟦Acts 20:10|Ac 20:10⟧.†

G4845.b:
⟪συν-πληρόω⟫
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 25:12|Je 25:12⟧ (⁨מָלֵא⁩) * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to fill up completely⟫ (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, ⟦Luke 8:23|Lk 8:23⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to complete, fulfil⟫: of time (⟦Jeremiah 25:12|Je, l.c.⟧, and v. MM, xxiv), ⟦Luke 9:51|Lk 9:51⟧, ⟦Acts 2:1|Ac 2:1⟧ (on the "durative inf.," v. M, Pr., 233).†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G4846.b: * ⟪συν-πνίγω⟫ (Rec. συμπ-), ⟪to choke⟫: of thronging by a crowd, ⟦Luke 8:42|Lk 8:42⟧. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, ⟦Matthew 13:22|Mt 13:22⟧, ⟦Mark 4:7|Mk 4:7⟧, ⟦Mark 4:19|19⟧, ⟦Luke 8:14|Lk 8:14⟧.†

G4847.b: * ⟪συν-πολίτης⟫ (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ ⟪a fellow-citizen⟫: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opp. to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, ⟦Ephesians 2:19|Eph 2:19⟧ (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†
a: The New Phrynichus, by W. G. Rutherford. Macmillan, 1881

G4848.b:
⟪συν-πορεύομαι⟫
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨הלךְ⁩ ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to journey together⟫ (Plat., al.): c. dat. pers., ⟦Luke 7:11|Lk 7:11⟧ ⟦Luke 14:25|14:25⟧ ⟦Luke 24:15|24:15⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to come together⟫: ⟦Mark 10:1|Mk 10:1⟧ (Plut., al.).†

G4852.b: * ⟪σύν-φημι⟫ (Rec. συμ-), ⟪to consent, confess⟫: c. dat., seq. ὅτι, ⟦Romans 7:16|Ro 7:16⟧.†

G4855.b:
** ⟪συν-φύω⟫
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wi 13:13 * ;] ⟪to cause to grow together⟫. Pass., ⟪to grow together or with⟫ (Plat. al.): ⟦Luke 8:7|Lk 8:7⟧.†
